epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Wimbledon 2008 men's final is considered as the greatest of all time… Roland Garros is an emblematic place…. Naomi Osaka is a citizen of world tennis while Novak Djokovic has made history in Australia.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wimbledon 2008 men's final is considered as the greatest of all time… Roland Garros is an emblematic place…. Naomi Osaka is a citizen of world tennis while Novak Djokovic has made history in Australia.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Top 10 is an exclusive ranking of the news or the champions who are causing a buzz on planet sport!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Top 10 is an exclusive ranking of the news or the champions who are causing a buzz on planet sport!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: From 2004 to 2008, Michael Phelps was invincible, rewriting the history of the Olympic Games.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From 2004 to 2008, Michael Phelps was invincible, rewriting the history of the Olympic Games.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Chad le Clos shocked the world, Michael Phelps proved that he was the greatest Olympic athlete, while swimsuits changed swimming and Katie Ledecky could simply not be beaten.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chad le Clos shocked the world, Michael Phelps proved that he was the greatest Olympic athlete, while swimsuits changed swimming and Katie Ledecky could simply not be beaten.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: David Beckham's career changed following a red card. The journey of Michael Phelps began by simply climbing on the highest step of the podium. And Eric the Eel won many hearts.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: David Beckham's career changed following a red card. The journey of Michael Phelps began by simply climbing on the highest step of the podium. And Eric the Eel won many hearts.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The Top 20 is an exclusive ranking of the news or the champions who are causing a buzz on planet sport!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Top 20 is an exclusive ranking of the news or the champions who are causing a buzz on planet sport!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Jack Nicklaus has not only won more major championships than any other golfer, but he has also transformed this sport.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jack Nicklaus has not only won more major championships than any other golfer, but he has also transformed this sport.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The final of the men's 100 metres in Seoul in 1988 was not just the dirtiest in history… it stained this emblematic race for years to come.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The final of the men's 100 metres in Seoul in 1988 was not just the dirtiest in history… it stained this emblematic race for years to come.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Meet @mrblockworkout, ex-bad boy who has created his own fitness method using only the urban environment! See @jcbarny, @SebastienFoucan, @SinguilaMusic and @Vanessalemoigne take up his challenges in Cergy in the Parisian region (France).
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet @mrblockworkout, ex-bad boy who has created his own fitness method using only the urban environment! See @jcbarny, @SebastienFoucan, @SinguilaMusic and @Vanessalemoigne take up his challenges in Cergy in the Parisian region (France).

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: The greatest controversy of football, Maradona's Hand of God goal during the 1986 World Cup quarter final against England. And the rivalry in four combats between Manny Pacquiao and Juan Manuel Marquez. A look at the preparations, consequences and hot spots of sporting history.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The greatest controversy of football, Maradona's Hand of God goal during the 1986 World Cup quarter final against England. And the rivalry in four combats between Manny Pacquiao and Juan Manuel Marquez. A look at the preparations, consequences and hot spots of sporting history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一些外貌最奇特的鳥類都是驚人的倖存者.一個快跑者,一個潮流指標,一個清道夫,一個花花公子和一個浪漫人士.這些有翅怪物證明除了外表,牠們還有很多東西令你詫異.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One uses a mustache to attract mates and another has a bill so big, it needs special vertebrae to carry it. Learn how natures flying iconoclasts have evolved their appearance in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 隨著旱季開始,成千上萬的動物正前往相思環.每頭動物都必須在捕食順序中確立自己的位置,避免那些非常願意以粗心的動物作大餐的危險居民.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As the dry season begins, thousands of animals are making their way to the Acacia Loop. Each must establish their place in the pecking order and avoid the dangerous residents who are all too willing to make a meal of the unwary.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毛拉是麥茲家族中最年輕的小牛.隨著氣溫飆升,潟湖和水潭正在枯竭.逼使毛拉和牠的家人進行一次漫長而危險的旅程,前往唯一剩下的水源:盧安瓜河.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa River.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨剛畢業的貝尼,與同學蘇拉,梅里爾和威恩,一起展開明猩學園導賞團.拜訪剛報到的新生莫莉,並與納丁博士一起上課,看她如何為慢吞吞的布米和野孩子莫妮塔評分.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分.檢查三隻刺猬,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel heartbreak when Dr. Amandas team loses a pangolin abused by wildlife traffickers, but cheer when another is released post-rehab. Check on a trio of hedgehogs and tag along as the centers baboons and nyala antelopes get a change of scenery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈.然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍.檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strap in for Dr. Amandas risky attempt to collar a wild roan antelope. Later, chase down blue monkey Indigo while unrest ensues among the vervets. Examine an eagle owl with bumblefoot and say adieu to Sheila the croc, whos headed back to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與更多動物朋友仔見面,包括夏洛特,她是一隻喜歡與豚鼠朋友華萊士一起洗澡的史納莎,還有名叫咸美殊的公羊,他喜歡離群溜出去跟一群乳牛住在一起.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gawk at some of the worlds ugliest animals who owe their survival to the adaptations that made them so strange. A pudgy wolf eel, naked mole rat, and hideous sea lamprey may be superficially grotesque, but theyre evolutionarily amazing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性領袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊.也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一隻穿山甲被野生動物販運者虐待致死,阿曼達博士的團隊感到心碎,但另一隻穿山甲在康復後歸野,則令他們雀躍萬分.檢查三隻刺猬,跟隨中心的狒狒和安氏林羚轉換住處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Feel heartbreak when Dr. Amandas team loses a pangolin abused by wildlife traffickers, but cheer when another is released post-rehab. Check on a trio of hedgehogs and tag along as the centers baboons and nyala antelopes get a change of scenery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 準備觀看阿曼達博士冒險嘗試給野馬羚套上頸圈.然後,長尾猴發生騷亂,因此要追蹤藍冕狐猴- 阿藍.檢查一隻長了趾瘤的雕鴞,然後向即將返回野外的鱷魚希拉說再見.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Strap in for Dr. Amandas risky attempt to collar a wild roan antelope. Later, chase down blue monkey Indigo while unrest ensues among the vervets. Examine an eagle owl with bumblefoot and say adieu to Sheila the croc, whos headed back to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 了解南美洲多變的氣候如何孕育更豐富多樣的生命.尋找亞馬遜雨林中能夠「呼吸」氧氣的樹木,追隨廣闊的雲河軌跡,並拜會能在猛烈紫外線下茁壯成長的紅鶴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how South Americas rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforests oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the suns scorching UV rays.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入清澈見底的海洋,探索圖巴塔哈礁,這片礁體坐落在一座已熄滅的海底火山之上;那裡的淺潟湖庇護著海龜與鼬鯊.也與眼鏡猴一同騰躍飛掠,看牠們靠著樹木之間強而有力的跳躍來獵捕昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索紐西蘭北部偏遠群島三王群島的奇異魔力.與寬吻海豚一起游泳,加入短尾黃貂魚的狩獵,感受一群食肉虎鯨出現時的緊張氣氛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Delve into the strange magic of the Three Kings Islands, a remote archipelago north of New Zealand. Swim with a pod of bottlenose dolphins, join short-tailed stingrays on a hunt, and feel the tension as a gang of predatory orcas arrives on the scene.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起來看看貪吃鬼貝尼如何闖禍,並從當地的雄性��袖彼得魯克得到令其顫抖的教訓.見證曾經是非法寵物的富家孩子斯潘瑟,如何嘗試控制自己的甜食癮,再跟隨布米和格蕾塔進行一次瘋狂的冒險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在由火山,森林與海洋塑造而成,彼此緊密相連的野生生命之中.與稀有的菲律賓鷹一同飛翔,看牠們在一棵古老大樹裡養育幼鳥;接著潛入河流,設法一瞥世界上最稀有的鱷魚.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 世上到處都是令人毛骨悚然的爬行者,但不要被牠們的外表所迷惑 - 牠們都有厲害的生存技能.從裝死,到自發性移除尾巴,至足夠強壯來舉起牠們體重30倍的東西,這些昆蟲以其驚人的適應性征服世界.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the tiny creatures that make us squirm while hiding admirable survival skills. From playing dead, removing a tail, or being able to lift objects 30 times their weight, these insects conquer the world with their amazing adaptations.

epg.programme_title_tc: 美國野生邊界:北部揭祕 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著美加之間最長的邊境,野生動物猶如同時活在兩個世界.動物在障礙和矛盾的規則間如履薄冰,一念天堂一念地獄.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 每個王國都需要一個傳位制度,生兒育女,是每個物種的生存之道.在某些社交圈,需要一整條村子來維繫家庭,但又有些只有單親父母能在野外的威脅中保護幼兒.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every empire needs a succession plan. Making babies – and raising them – is crucial for every species to survive. In some social circles, it takes a village to raise a family. In others, a single parent is all that stands between the vulnerability...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索美麗的海德堡城堡,它的廢墟屹立在德國西部的內卡河旁.這座城堡位於受保護的自然保育區中,是猛禽的家園,亦是附近兩棲類的產卵場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往擁有數百年歷史的法國堡壘,它是史上一些最偉大帝國的家園.卡爾卡松曾是財富和文化的中心,如今已成為野生動物的避難所.鳥類,野豬和昆蟲大軍在其豐裕的環境中生存.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of historys greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 發掘刻在洞穴裡世上最大的城堡.斯洛文尼亞的洞窟城堡不僅為中世紀的人類居民提供了保護,而且還為該區的鳥類,野豬和野山羊提供了避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the worlds largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 遊覽西班牙格林納達地區一生必到的非凡堡壘- 阿爾罕布拉宮.這個世界文化遺產現在成了該地區野生動植物的庇護所.它擁有眾多溪流和噴泉,可供應兩棲類,魚類和鳥類.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spains Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the regions wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解世上最壯觀的建築之一 - 新天鵝堡及其周邊的森林如何成為許多生物的家園.從阿爾卑斯羱羊到雄偉的天鵝,這座城堡於數世紀以來成了天然避難所.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how one of the worlds most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the Arctic for a peek at the brutal challenges of life in the boreal forest, then admire some stellar animal adaptations. Witness a secret reindeer superpower, navigate a rodent labyrinth of snow, and learn why moose are gourmets at heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索地球上的森林如何連結和滋養著無數物種的生命.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Learn how plants and animals tough it out in some of the driest terrain Earth has to offer. Run across thirsty trees that act as elephant signposts, see insects team up with plants for a chance at life, and get insight into natural chemical warfare.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一隻鴨子若沒有她的狗仔朋友搭載,就決不下水,一頭以為自己是野牛的大象,還有一群收養了一隻小鹿孤兒的母牛.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that wont go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks shes a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與更多動物朋友仔見面,包括夏洛特,她是一隻喜歡與豚鼠朋友華萊士一起洗澡的史納莎,還有名叫咸美殊的公羊,他喜歡離群溜出去跟一群乳牛住在一起.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 今集動物朋友仔中,一頭被救出的犀牛孤兒跟一隻貪玩的小狗和一隻充滿愛的綿羊成為朋友,一隻大兔子照料一頭精力旺盛的小羊,還有一隻箭豬幫助兩隻英國鬥牛犬為受傷動物復健.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃.一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達���特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 搜尋失踪的孤兒拉黑伊,並見證害羞的魯姆巴在築巢課上,嘗試使用她虛弱的左手.見證年輕的黛麗拉在課堂上如何教訓布米,並看看班尼和瓦倫蒂諾能否合格,最終贏得自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 恭喜明猩學園的應屆畢業生,並見證他們的茁壯成長!跟隨車隊前往典禮現場,見證團隊向每一位踏上新旅途的明猩朋友作真摯告別,然後舉行熱鬧的畢業慶祝活動!而莫莉和布米也成功升班.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who arent all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在由駱駝艾伯特與他的人類朋友亞歷克斯共同打理的牧場巡視,接著探訪小袋鼠賀比,他正被好友弗勒細心照顧.與袋鼬昆西一起製造一點混亂,並和衝浪山羊丘帕卡布拉一起掛在浪上.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意.稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow Shanet, who spends her days tending to the needs of Harold Custard the rockhopper penguin, and feel the love as Barista cares for Cindy the baboon in her golden years. Later, say an emotional goodbye as Rocco the wombat returns to the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃.一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從水豚的半豬半河馬外觀,到三帶犰狳,至鞭蛛,誰是看來像地獄中的惡魔,但卻是蛛形綱中的最好媽媽?本集將向你展示世上一些最奇怪的動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Are they guinea pigs, beavers, or something else? Capybaras embody the features of several different animals at once, as do warthogs, anteaters, and other fascinating genetic hybrids. Learn why these wannabes display such particular physical traits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存.但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?秘「蜜」日記講述這個故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bees Diary tells that story.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從古至今,很多物種都被絕種危機所威脅.就如強極一時的恐龍帝國,亦在地球上消失殆盡.但另外一些則從滅絕邊緣生存下來,慢慢恢復甚至在自然界中建立王國.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires – like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounc...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude).目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Navigate the harsh Mongolian wilderness with Dan as he searches for The Dude, the largest snow leopard ever recorded. Watch him battle hostile landscapes and uncertainty as he sheds light on the challenges that The Dude and other snow leopards face.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力.當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sniff around The Dudes territory with Dan and his team, who suspect that females may play a bigger role than they originally thought. Challenge previous research about snow leopard behaviour when Dan stumbles upon an unusual cluster of big cats.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食.在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與鱷魚爭奪河流的主導權,展開對支配權的激烈較量,然後一瞥極為罕見的紅樹林蛇,以及瀕臨絕種的納巴勒克小袋鼠.前往海洋,看見座頭鯨的母鯨撫育牠們的幼鯨,接著又遭到偽虎鯨的追逐與獵捕.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

epg.programme_title_tc: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沉浸在地球上最大,保存最完整的稀樹草原之中;在那裡,哺乳動物和昆蟲都能毫不費力地飛掠空中.了解傳統的野火管理方法,探索一處砂岩避難地,並看著一隻蜜袋鼯試著逃離火焰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Bask in the largest intact savannah on the planet, where mammals and insects fly through the air with the greatest of ease. Study traditional wildfire-management methods, explore a sandstone refuge, and watch a sugar glider try to escape the flames.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潘塔納爾濕地是世上最大的動植物保護區之一.科學家估計它是80種哺乳類,650種鳥類,50種爬行類和300多種魚類的家.它是地球上最大的熱帶濕地,但也是最嚴苛的棲息地之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Pantanal experiences extreme climatic shifts, from brutal droughts during the searingly hot dry season to floods created by rainy-season tempests. See how the regions diverse animal population works to coexist and ensure collective survival.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #1 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 視野對生存尤關重要.這是百分之九十五的動物瞭解世界的方法.眼睛是如此重要,從難以置信地簡單到令人費解地複雜,它們已經獨立地進化了近百次.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Vision – its how ninety-five percent of animals interpret the world. Every species on Earth is a chapter in the fascinating story of sight. This episode follows that story from blurry beginnigs to mind-blowing hexnocular vision.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #2 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 看看那些突破物理,化學和工程極限的動物,牠們實現人類夢想中的能力,並找出進化如何賦予牠們如此驚人的能力.有時生存只能依靠超能力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the animals that push the limits of physics, chemistry and engineering to pull off feats that humans can only dream of, and find out how evolution granted them with such amazing abilities. Sometimes it takes a super-power just to survive.

epg.programme_title_tc: 動物超感官 第一季 #3 [英/普]
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 潛入人類感知以外令人眼花繚亂的世界,動物利用牠們的超感官來感測我們看不到的光,聽不到的聲音,甚至是我們無法察覺的陌生力量.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a dazzling world beyond human perception, where animals use their super senses to detect light we cant see, sound we cant hear and even stranger forces we cant begin to detect.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞拉國家公園中陰暗的森林,對行縱隱密的豹來說是完美的藏身之所;而年輕的䧳豹阿莎亦準備好獨自闖蕩.一起見證她爭奪自己的領地,尋找伴侶,到成為母親的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The shadowy forests of Yala National Park are the perfect hideout for secretive leopards. Its time for one young female, Asha, to strike out alone. Join her as she fights for her own territory, finds a mate, and becomes a mother.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get acquainted with an array of ocean oddballs and learn how billions of years worth of changes, from ice ages to asteroid strikes, have shaped their looks and skills. Meet blind worms who fish, walking sharks, tree-climbing crabs, and much more.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因.團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊,公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Embark on a dangerous tagging mission in South Australia that will show what sharks eat and why they gather in feeding hot spots. Then head north as a team chases tiger, bull, and hammerhead sharks and outfits one with a 360-degree dorsal camera.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地.然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤.然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能.然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of Australias shark highways. Find out if Greenly Island in the south is a truck stop for migrating great whites, then search for proof of a genetic connection between northern bull sharks and their cooler-climate cousins.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊.然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 熟悉各種海洋怪咖,從冰河時期到小行星撞擊,瞭解數十億年來的變化,如何塑造牠們的外表和技能.認識會釣魚的蛇蜥,跑行的鯊魚,爬樹的螃蟹等.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物王國充滿了詭詐,模仿和變形;許多生物都有一手絕活.本集中的四種動物本身都是「騙子」.牠們使用偽裝和混亂欺騙我們和其他動物.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The animal kingdom is filled with mimicry, transformation, and trickery. Discover how stick bugs, lion fish, emperor scorpions, and chameleons use camouflage and confusion to deceive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 前往桑布魯,看看在當地的一條河流乾涸后,女族長阿納斯塔西亞如何領著牠的象群向北方前進.然後來到納波西奧,看看獵豹母親庫萊塔如何躲避狡猾的獵狗群.最後,在萊基皮亞,看看野狗菲尼克斯和牠的新窩.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大象挖井的巧妙方式,看到突然間使河水滿溢的傾盆大雨帶來的歡喜.在獅子殺死獵豹的一隻幼崽後,為庫萊塔的喪子之痛而哀悼.並在野狗菲尼克斯與兇狠的獵狗對峙時觀看實時戰況.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuletas loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏.認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celebrate Cash the house donkeys birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥.見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起拜會潘塔納爾美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,從旁觀察她教導淘氣的幼寶寶辛巴如何爬樹和捕獵.然後看看另一隻雌豹菲琳娜如何面對更多當地雄豹入侵領土,並威脅幼寶寶的存活.面對考驗,她必須為母職掙扎堅持.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,動物收容所的一隻小狗幫助被帶回的小獵豹為回到野外做準備,一隻受傷的猴子贏得一群冷漠狗隻的歡心,還有一隻喜歡與一群羊一起覓食孤獨的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亞洲最大的象群每年都會齊集於米內瑞亞國家公園舉行盛會;而在本年的周年大會上,於這片神聖的地方,小象洛卡誕生了!一起見證他在大象的混戰中學習進食,游泳和使用他的象鼻.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every year, the biggest elephant congregation in Asia occurs in Minneriya National Park. Here in this sacred place, baby Loka is born. Watch as he learns to suckle, swim and handle his trunk among the mêlée of giants that make up his family.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Track a pregnant shark along the Great Barrier Reef and see if she leads a team of scientists to her hidden pupping ground. Then search for signs of mating along the southern coast that could reveal a very shy female megashark in search of a partner.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 暴龍和雞似乎風馬牛不相及,但牠們可能比你想像更多共通點.最近的研究表示,我們最喜歡的一些恐龍跟鳥類十分相似,鳥類是現存的一種恐龍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: T-Rex and chickens seem to be as different as they can be, but they more in common that you might think. Recent research reveals that some of our favorite dinosaurs were very birdlike, and that birds are an extant kind of dinosaurs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況.佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了.了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非海岸的岩石島嶼上,成千上萬的動物聚首等待繁殖.其中,巨大的開普塘鵝群佔大多數.被豐富的水資源環繞,牠們可以找到足夠的食物來養活自己和幼鵝,但牠們的生命仍然充滿挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full o...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東開普省正在致力投資生態旅遊和保育,以替代捕魚和商業開發.該處為了野生生態正在開墾農田,關閉漁場.這是最令人興奮的非洲保育成功故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Eastern Cape Province is investing heavily in ecotourism and conservation as an alternative to fishing and commercial development. The region is reclaiming farmlands and closing fishing grounds for wildlife. This is one of the most exciting co...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨麗茲·戴利及其團隊前往潘塔納爾,追尋一隻失蹤的雄性美洲豹領袖,並親眼目睹年輕挑戰者之間的戰鬥.見證局外人巴達洛如何篡奪權力,並贏得菲拉和其他雌性美洲豹的歡心.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起拜會潘塔納爾美洲豹族群的女王菲拉,從旁觀察她教導淘氣的幼寶寶辛巴如何爬樹和捕獵.然後看看另一隻雌豹菲琳娜如何面對更多當地雄豹入侵領土,並威脅幼寶寶的存活.面對考驗,她必須為母職掙扎堅持.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Get to know Fera, the Queen of the Pantanal, as she teaches her rambunctious cub Simba how to climb trees and hunt for dinner. Then learn why Ferinha, another local female, struggles with motherhood as more males move in and threaten the youngsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤.然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stay up late as the northern team attaches an activity tag to a bull shark and finds out what this night owl does after sunset. Then dive 80 meters deep with the southern team, who are hoping to put a satellite tracker on a female great white.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非海岸的岩石島嶼上,成千上萬的動物聚首等待繁殖.其中,巨大的開普塘鵝群佔大多數.被豐富的水資源環繞,牠們可以找到足夠的食物來養活自己和幼鵝,但牠們的生命仍然充滿挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full o...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東開普省正在致力投資生態旅遊和保育,以替代捕魚和商業開發.該處為了野生生態正在開墾農田,關閉漁場.這是最令人興奮的非洲保育成功故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Eastern Cape Province is investing heavily in ecotourism and conservation as an alternative to fishing and commercial development. The region is reclaiming farmlands and closing fishing grounds for wildlife. This is one of the most exciting co...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集動物朋友仔有一群急救中心的猴子,收養了一群小流浪貓;一頭忠心的狗幫助一隻浣熊克服她的恐懼;還有愛爾蘭雪達犬們養育了一隻鴯鶓.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 斯里蘭卡的低地遍布著數千個看似平靜的湖泊,但「湖」不可貌相,湖水中盡是沼澤鱷的天下.沼澤鱷生來就是獵人,一起來看看這些頂尖獵食者在炙熱的環境中如何互相競爭.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sri Lankas lowlands are dotted with thousands of seemingly peaceful lakes, but dont be fooled, this is the realm of the mugger crocodile. Muggers are hunters from day one. Watch as these supreme predators compete with each other in the fierce heat.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 小獵豹烏珊娜生長在不利環境中.很少小獵豹能夠撐過一歲.但她很幸運,有一位厲害的母親,她會不惜一切保護幼崽安全.烏珊娜只需跟隨她的腳步.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, shes got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在救援中心享受春季幼崽潮的工作人員們因一群可愛的負鼠寶寶而陷入瘋狂.隨後看到救援隊在屋頂的露台做了簡單的休整,找回並拯救了棲息在城市的高樓上的鴨媽媽和它的小鴨子們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Enjoy the spring baby boom at the center as the staff go gaga over an adorable bundle of baby possums. Then see the rescue team hit a rooftop patio for a little R and R: retrieving and rescuing a mama and her ducklings perched high above the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非海岸的岩石島嶼上,成千上萬的動物聚首等待繁殖.其中,巨大的開普塘鵝群佔大多數.被豐富的水資源環繞,牠們可以找到足夠的食物來養活自己和幼鵝,但牠們的生命仍然充滿挑戰.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孤兒塞西亞患上瘧疾,團隊正努力遏止疾病在明猩學園中蔓延,並評估代母斯里幫助布米的計劃.一起看看紅毛猩猩媽媽達普特對女同學的積極影響;並目暏令人震驚的食物偷竊事件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sris plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生.從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬.在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能.然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 認識更多動物朋友仔,包括「牧場經理」巴克萊,一頭恰巧是馴馬天才的大丹犬.在非洲,一隻名為「雷神」的小狨猴迷戀兩隻年青獲救的獴.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including ranch manager Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群.跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點.走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insects.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南非海岸的岩石島嶼上,成千上萬的動物聚首等待繁殖.其中,巨大的開普塘鵝群佔大多數.被豐富的水資源環繞,牠們可以找到足夠的食物來養活自己和幼鵝,但牠們的生命仍然充滿挑戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full o...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東開普省正在致力投資生態旅遊和保育,以替代捕魚和商業開發.該處為了野生生態正在開墾農田,關閉漁場.這是最令人興奮的非洲保育成功故事之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Eastern Cape Province is investing heavily in ecotourism and conservation as an alternative to fishing and commercial development. The region is reclaiming farmlands and closing fishing grounds for wildlife. This is one of the most exciting co...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能.然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ponder shark community hierarchies as the northern team studies how young blacktips learn social and survival skills. Then rush to Rainbow Beach with the southern team, who are eager to witness the sand tiger sharks most elusive behaviour: mating.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 來看看工作人員照顧一隻被狗咬傷的小兔子,隨後加入該救援中心的放生團隊,將一隻被遺棄的小天鵝介紹給收養的天鵝媽媽,但是事情似乎沒有完全按照計劃進行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See staff care for baby bunnies injured in a dog attack and then join the centers release team as they introduce an abandoned cygnet to an adoptive mother swan, and find that things dont go exactly as planned.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演.從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 搜尋失踪的孤兒拉黑伊,並見證害羞的魯姆巴在築巢課上,嘗試使用她虛弱的左手.見證年輕的黛麗拉在課堂上如何教訓布米,並看看班尼和瓦倫蒂諾能否合格,最終贏得自由.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一起走訪野生動物急診室,與團隊共渡忙碌的夏季!觀察艾蜜莉獸醫為一隻脹氣的無尾熊媽媽減壓.並與團隊應對在彩虹鸚鵡之間傳播的癱瘓症.見證卡琳娜獸醫以一隻泰迪熊拯救狐蝠幼寶寶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dive into a busy summer at the RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, where vet Emily takes the pressure off a gassy koala mum. Shadow the team as they fight a wave of lorikeet paralysis syndrome and see vet Karina use a teddy bear to rescue a flying fox pup.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 跟隨獸醫艾蜜莉和瑪婷進入手術室,見證她們為無尾熊多莉進行的結紮手術,過程出現驚險轉折.與獸醫奈杰爾一同救治被撞倒的針鼴,看看香緹爾如何巧妙地解救一隻被困的蜥蜴,並與獸醫卡琳娜調查一宗懷疑鳥類綁架案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join vets Emily and Martine in the OR, where Dolly the koalas spaying surgery takes a scary turn. Aid a run-over echidna with vet Nigel, see rescue officer Chantelles slick fix for a snared lizard, and probe a possible birdnapping with vet Karina.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巡视「海灣」家族郁郁蔥蔥的領土,在這裡女族長安娜向族人提供奢華的盛宴,但也面臨著內部的異議.打量她的對手米婭--頗具街頭智慧的「城裡人」家族領導者,她正在考慮改善生活方式,並向與世隔絕的「紅樹林」家族打探消息.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Stake out the Bay Familys lush territory, where matriarch Anna offers lavish feasts but faces internal dissent. Size up her rival Mia, the streetwise Townies leader whos eyeing a lifestyle upgrade, and check in with the isolated Mangrove Family.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monsoon storms sweep over the tropical island of Sri Lanka, and water carried in with swirling mists hits the mountainous heartland, beginning a journey through the many changing faces of the islands forests.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In post-war Italy, a working-class man's bicycle is stolen, endangering his efforts to find work. He and his son set out to find it.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部紀錄片帶領觀眾深入且全面地回顧萊昂內爾・梅西的非凡職業生涯--從阿根廷羅薩裡奧的平凡起點,到成為全球足球傳奇巨星的歷程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This documentary offers an intimate and comprehensive journey through the extraordinary career of Lionel Messi - from his humble beginnings in Rosario, Argentina, to becoming a global football icon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從小鎮天才到世界第一,這部紀錄片記錄了穆雷追求卓越的堅持,與傷病的搏鬥,以及他作為網壇最具啟發性人物之一的永恆傳奇.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From a small-town prodigy to World No. 1, Andy Murray: Game Set Match chronicles his relentless pursuit of greatness, his battles with injury, and his enduring legacy as one of tenniss most inspiring figures.

epg.programme_title_tc: 基利安姆巴佩:足壇新星
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 很少有球員能像基利安・姆巴佩一樣,捕捉全球球迷的想像力.在短短十多年內,他從默默無名的新秀,迅速躍升為世界上最知名,最具影響力的足球明星之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: There are few players who capture the imagination of fans worldwide quite like Kylian Mbappé. In just over a decade, he went from absolute obscurity to becoming one of the most famous players in the world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成,新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大另類療法,並瞭解那些至今仍保留傳統的療法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwans top five alternative therapies and learns about those keeping traditional ways of healing alive today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐.跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores Taiwans top five Western food with a Taiwanese twist. Join her as she learns why these have become so popular among locals and tourists alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟.跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores top five temples to visit in Taipei. Join her as she learns about the deities worshipped in these temples and what people pray for at each.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大原住民美食.跟她參觀兩個原住民村莊,並瞭解這些食物的製作方法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores Taiwan’s top five Indigenous delicacies. Join her as she visits two Indigenous villages and learns about how these food are made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大獨特街頭美食.她也嘗試製作一些,並瞭解它們各具特色的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwans top five unique street foods. She tries to make some and learns what makes each of them so special.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索五大臺灣製造的頂尖發明.細訴這些改變生活的物品的起源,並瞭解為何那麼多人喜歡它們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores top five inventions that were made in Taiwan. She details the origins of these life-changing items and learns why many love them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣地鐵站五大裝置藝術,並細訴它們如何呼應這些車站的地理位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwan’s top five installation artworks located in subway stations and details how they echo the geographical location of these stations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大咖啡品牌.她向獲獎的咖啡師們瞭解能在激烈競爭中脫穎而出的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwan’s top coffee brands. She sits with award-winning baristas and learns about what keeps them going among so much competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅.從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a future where bio-threats present one of the greatest existential risks that humanity has ever faced. From viruses to man-made pandemics and synthetic bio-weapons, technology is accelerating the risks of man-made threats.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智慧統治著地球和我們.人工智慧將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Edge of Existence explores a near-future where artificial intelligence rules the planet, and us. AI will arrive in our life-times bringing with it the biggest existential risk humanity has ever faced.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩,混亂而夢幻的費茲.雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley lands in Morocco, but he doesnt go to Marrakesch or Casablanca, but to the colourful, chaotic and dreamy city of Fes. The sprawling medina is a World Heritage site and a gateway to another time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ainsley visits Georgetown, the capital of Penang island, where Malaysians come to discover the best street food in this food-obsessed country.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克,黎巴嫩,巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On the final leg of his culinary journey, Ainsley visits Amman in Jordan, the crossroads in the Middle East that families from Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine and Syria now call home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 席琳.狄翁是家喻戶曉的名字,象徵著無與倫比的音樂才華.然而,她的人生並非一帆風順.跟隨我們一同揭開傳奇背後的故事--從聲名鵲起的爆紅之路,到塑造她非凡事業的個人考驗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.programme_title_tc: 摩根費裡曼:不可思議的生涯
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 深入探索摩根・費裡曼的人生旅程--從奮鬥與逆境,到塑造好萊塢的傳奇地位與獨一無二的標誌性嗓音.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Journey through the life of Morgan Freeman-his struggles, triumphs, and legendary voice that shaped Hollywood and beyond.

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物.冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大獨特街頭美食.她也嘗試製作一些,並瞭解它們各具特色的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwans top five unique street foods. She tries to make some and learns what makes each of them so special.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索五大臺灣製造的頂尖發明.細訴這些改變生活的物品的起源,並瞭解為何那麼多人喜歡它們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores top five inventions that were made in Taiwan. She details the origins of these life-changing items and learns why many love them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣地鐵站五大裝置藝術,並細訴它們如何呼應這些車站的地理位置.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwan’s top five installation artworks located in subway stations and details how they echo the geographical location of these stations.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大咖啡品牌.她向獲獎的咖啡師們瞭解能在激烈競爭中脫穎而出的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwan’s top coffee brands. She sits with award-winning baristas and learns about what keeps them going among so much competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣製的頂級麵包和糕點.她向獲獎的烘焙師取經,瞭解他們的作品值得被認可的原因.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores top-notch breads and pastries from Taiwan. She talks with award-winning bakers and learns what makes their creations worth the recognition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣便利店的五大隱藏功能.她逛逛附近的一家便利店,發現它不僅是一個喝咖啡和吃零食的地方.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores the top five hidden functions of convenience stores in Taiwan. She tours around a convenience store in her neighborhood and discovers that its more than just a place to grab coffee and snacks.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺灣的頂級水果,從菠蘿到蓮霧.她學習這些水果的大小事,以及為何能全年享用它們.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores Taiwans top fruits, from pineappples to wax apples. She learns all about these fruits and why they can be enjoyed all year-round.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 與祖莉來一場異國冒險,進入臺灣動物世界!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join Jolie on an exotic adventure into the world of Animals in Taiwan!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在本集引人入勝的《臺灣之最》,與主持人祖莉一起揭開臺灣夜生活的秘密.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Join host Jolie as she unravels the secrets of Taiwan nightlife in this captivating episode of Taiwan Top 5.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大另類療法,並瞭解那些至今仍保留傳統的療法.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Peggy explores Taiwans top five alternative therapies and learns about those keeping traditional ways of healing alive today.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐.跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores Taiwans top five Western food with a Taiwanese twist. Join her as she learns why these have become so popular among locals and tourists alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟.跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores top five temples to visit in Taipei. Join her as she learns about the deities worshipped in these temples and what people pray for at each.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被徵服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rob journeys along the length of the Panama Canal to learn how the un-conquerable Isthmus was bent to the will and skill of determined engineers, creating one of the seven wonders of the Modern World.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From stormy seas to the land locked Mojave Desert, Rob discovers the amazing story of how the mighty Colorado was tamed and the Hoover Dam built.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通過警察的音頻和視頻,還有當地及國家新聞報道,審 視2002年華盛頓特區的狙擊手襲擊事件.狙擊手為期三週的恐怖統治引發了美國史上最激烈,最複雜的搜捕行動之一.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine the 2002 sniper attacks in Washington D.C. through police audio and video, as well as local and national news reports. The sniper’s three-week reign of terror triggered one of the most intense and complicated manhunts in American history.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過罕見的檔案錄像審視民權社運人士麥爾坎X的迅速崛起和悲劇下場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See the meteoric rise and tragic end of civil rights activist Malcolm X, captured by rarely seen archival footage.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.programme_title_tc: 丹佐華盛頓:美國代表人物
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部深度紀錄片探討丹佐・華盛頓的非凡歷程,這位影壇巨星重新定義了好萊塢領銜男演員的形象與影響力.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This in-depth documentary explores the remarkable journey of Denzel Washington, a powerhouse actor who has redefined what it means to be a leading man in Hollywood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 溫布頓體育館的榮譽委員會充滿了傑出的名字.在1998 年,又添一個.羅渣費達拿.從任何意義上來說,他登上男子比賽巔峰的旅程就是真正的冠軍之旅.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wimbledon Stadium’s Honour Board is full of illustrious names. And in 1998, another emerged. Roger Federer. His journey to the top of the men’s game is the one of a true champion, in every sense of the word.

epg.programme_title_tc: 大衛艾登堡:地球上的一段生命旅程
epg.programme_title_en: David Attenborough: A Life On Earth
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大衛艾登堡爵士是一位傳奇的傳播者和教育家,在過去六十多年裡遊歷全球,用他那引人入勝的說故事技巧啟發數百萬人,並將自然世界帶入我們家中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Sir David Attenborough, a legendary communicator and educator, has traveled the world for over six decades, inspiring millions with his captivating storytelling and bringing the natural world into our homes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通過警察的音頻和視頻,還有當地及國家新聞報道,審 視2002年華盛頓特區的狙擊手襲擊事件.狙擊手為期三週的恐怖統治引發了美國史上最激烈,最複雜的搜捕行動之一.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the story of President Clintons impeachment, presented through archival footage of the day.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這股洋流伴隨著智利獨特的藍鯨族群,也是其他極度稀有海洋哺乳動物的最後避風港.從冰冷深海到高崖強風,洋流塑造出奇特棲地,也是一部關於生存的自然研究.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The current is followed by a unique population of Chilean blue whales and is the last refuge for other extremely rare marine mammals. From the chill of its deepest depths to the wind on its highest cliffs the current creates unusual habitats and is a

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春,夏,冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限:潛水探險,水上飛行器,揮桿高爾夫,快艇狂飆--最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Dubai, Luke goes all out with adrenaline-packed dives, jetpacking thrills, golf swings, and speedboat races-then shares Potter memories over dinner...the loser picks up the tab!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激:徵服壯麗塔特拉山,漂流急湍河道,探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Poland, Sophie trades a calm weekend for a rush of adventure: trekking the towering Tatras, rafting wild rivers, uncovering a legendary salt mine, and so much more!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在因斯布魯克,雙胞胎帶海莉闖入阿爾卑斯仙境,飛馳滑雪,雪車衝刺,盡情暢飲,重溫童星榮耀時刻--還有神秘魔法驚喜!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Innsbruck, the twins whisk Haley to an alpine wonderland of skiing, bobsledding, après-ski drinks, and a magical trip down childhood stardom-plus a touch of witchcraft!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在愛爾蘭,雙胞胎與伊凡娜一家共享曲棍球對決,傳統舞蹈,《哈利波特》回憶殺,並揭開詭譎迷人的鄉間冒險序幕!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Ireland, the twins join Evanna and her family for hurling matches, traditional dance, Potter nostalgia, and a spine-tingling countryside adventure!

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐.跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores Taiwans top five Western food with a Taiwanese twist. Join her as she learns why these have become so popular among locals and tourists alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟.跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jolie explores top five temples to visit in Taipei. Join her as she learns about the deities worshipped in these temples and what people pray for at each.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在世界著名的克魯格國家公園及附近開展第二趟南非美食之行.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren commences his second Food Trail of South Africa in the world famous Kruger National Park and surrounds.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 約翰尼斯堡是探索南非的門戶城市!華倫在本集沉迷於深受當地人和遊客喜愛的桑頓區及周邊和精彩的國際口味.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一.從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The instinct to secure a mate is one of the most powerful that there is. From the beautiful to the bizarre, this episode explores the most amazing mating rituals from right across the animal kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores the world’s most toxic animals, revealing how poison and venom have given them the edge over the competition in their fight for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This episode explores how nature’s toughest animals have adapted to the extreme conditions in some of the planet’s most inhospitable environments.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春,夏,冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This stunning series uncovers The Secret Life Of Owls as never seen before, using a special camera rig to follow families of owls in a wild corner of rural Essex, through winter, spring and summer.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態.從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s diverse landscapes host unique wildlife. From Cork Oak forests in the south to deciduous forests in the north, follow iconic species through key life phases, from mating to survival in the wild.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海.探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Rivers are lifelines in Wild Portugal, connecting mountains to the sea. Discover the Deer stag, frogs spring rituals, and Grebes dances, along with other animals and landscapes along these vital waterways.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統.在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Portugal’s coastal waters and the Azores archipelago boast rich ecosystems. Explore the diverse species living in these waters and discover their unique lives in this revealing episode.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Volunteers explore the community’s role in conservation, with thrilling honey harvesting, a new addition to the team, and a dream come true as one feeds a black rhino.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness how Americas South and Midwest were ravaged by 148 twisters in just 18 hours.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From heiress of a giant media empire to wanted felon, witness the strange saga of the Patty Hearst kidnapping of 1974.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以當時報導山姆之子的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Immerse yourself in the drama of the Son of Sam murders, presented the way the events were covered at the time.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 要觀察這片充滿地質現象的土地,只能從高空欣賞其雄偉的真面貌.從散佈在海岸線上被遺忘的沉船到卡奧科蘭無解的仙女圈,納米比亞的秘密將被揭開.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Observe a land filled with geological phenomena whose majesty can only truly be appreciated from the sky. From forgotten shipwrecks strewn along the coastline to the unexplained fairy circles in Koakoveld, Namibias secrets will be revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在豐富多彩的非洲國家-尚比亞上空翱翔.包括世上最富有的人所打造的城市和擠滿世上最貧窮的人的市場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Soar over the richly diverse, African nation of Zambia. Including cities crafted by the worlds richest men and markets teeming with some of the worlds poorest people.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 細看英國蘭卡斯特轟炸機如何出廠並投入行動,對德國進行毀滅性攻擊.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the British bomber Lancaster flew out of the factory and into action, leading devastating attacks on Germany.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解龍捲風戰鬥轟炸機如何及為何在多年來不同場合都大派用場.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Discover how and why the fighter-bomber Panavia Tornado has been so useful in so many roles for so many years.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 從越戰的叢林到中東的沙漠戰爭,見證 F-111戰鬥轟炸機的行動.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Witness the fighter-bomber F-111 in action, from the jungle battles of Vietnam to the desert wars of the Middle East.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 探索大西洋的荒野和野生動物.冬天帶來嚴苛的風暴,苦難和衝突,大多數動物都要為生存而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Exploring the wilderness and wildlife of the Atlantic Ocean. Winter brings bitter storms, suffering and conflict, while most are battling to survive.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在冬天的尾巴,大西洋再度生機盎然.在深海水域過冬的魚群再度回歸.一對老鷹在完美捕魚點的高空築巢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As winter draws to a close, the Atlantic springs back to life. Fish that spent the winter out in the deeper water have returned. An eagle pair has set up home high above the perfect fishing spot.

epg.programme_title_en: Atlantic: A Year In The Wild #3
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 夏天代表食物充足,今年的幼崽們必須進食,長大並準備自立.對海鸚來說,當從懸崖頂的巢穴跳落大海時,實在是一次巨大的信仰之躍.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Summer means food is plentiful and this years youngsters must feed, grow and prepare to start life alone. For puffins its a massive leap of faith as they jump from their cliff-top nests into the ocean.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, we witness a desperate mission to save a spooked impala. The intelligence of these anti poaching elephants astounds everyone. And, there is always time for fun tasks.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Explore a 400 square mile region of the Pantanal where jaguars rule and life follows the seasonal rhythm of the water.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we meet some animal elders who help us understand the psychological mechanisms associated with long life and the positive social value long-lived animals bring to their communities.

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Johannesburg - the gateway city to exploring South Africa! In this episode Warren indulges in the vibrant international flavours and surrounds of the Sandton neighbourhood, loved by locals and visitors alike.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在你從未見過的南非狂野東北海岸,華倫會發現自己愛上那空蕩蕩的海灘,粗獷的開放汪洋和充滿野生河馬的水道.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wild northeast coast of South Africa is like nothing you』ve seen. And it’s here Warren will find himself romanced by empty beaches, rugged open oceans, and waterways filled with wild hippopotamus.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫在本集體驗當地豐富的野生物種,他主要在追蹤和尋找難以捉摸並瀕臨絕種的非洲野狗.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode, Warren experiences the abundance of wildlife here, centering his experience around tracking and finding the elusive and endangered African Wild Dog.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 花園大道果真是南非的滄海遺珠,它是一條延伸200公裡的沿海公路,以其迷人的多樣性和無出其右的荒野而聞名.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A true hidden gem of South Africa, the Garden Route is a 200km stretch of coastal highway known for its beguiling diversity and unparalleled spirit of wilderness.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華倫抵達開普敦,這不會是這座城市的平凡美食探索之旅;華倫在整集節目中致力深入研究南非一種特殊的烹飪風格- 開普馬來.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Warren has arrived into Cape Town. This won’t be your average culinary exploration of a city; Warren has dedicated the entire episode to diving into a specific style of South African cooking known as 『Cape Malay』.

epg.programme_title_en: Keanu Reeves: The One And Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 踏上基努・李維的人生旅程,回顧他的成長歲月,多變的影視作品,以及情感起伏,揭開這位備受愛戴的偶像魅力所在.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The journey of Keanu Reeves, travel through his youth, his versatile filmography and his many emotinal peaks and troughs to uncover what makes this fantastic icon so celebrated.

epg.programme_title_tc: 惠妮休斯頓: 天籟背後
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一段震撼人心的旅程,深入描繪惠妮.休斯頓如流星般崛起的人生--從福音音樂的根源到全球巨星的巔峰,揭開錯綜複雜的情感關係,與成癮搏鬥的陰影,以及那把曾無可動搖,最終令人心碎的嗓音,在她英年早逝前的起落沉浮.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A powerful journey into the meteoric rise of Whitney Houston - from her gospel roots to global superstardom - unraveling the tangled relationships, haunting battles with addiction, and the heartbreaking fall of a once-unshakable voice, before her unt

epg.programme_title_en: Celine Dion: The Heart Goes On

epg.episode_synopsis_en: Celine Dion is a household name, synonymous with musical brilliance. Yet, her life has not been untouched by hardship. Join us as we uncover the story behind the legend, her meteoric rise to fame, and the personal trials that shaped her remarkable ca

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: From their teeth, and claws, to incredible stealth and cunning, nature’s most lethal predators have evolved a staggering array of hunting techniques.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we witness nature’s most extraordinary animal migrations, and discover the lengths they must go to, in order to survive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 動物嬰兒:為了嬰兒免受極端情況,飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Baby Animals: Protecting babies against extreme conditions, hungry predators, and the threat of starvation, all animals must fight for the future of their species.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠交談.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this episode we explore animal communication and reveal the incredible adaptations that enable animals to 『talk』 to each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examining nature’s most sociable animals, unveiling the surprising and incredible behaviours that have evolved in response to cohabitation.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Showcasing some of nature’s most incredible animal minds, whose brains demonstrate high intelligence, enabling them to gain advantage of their competition.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事.儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Travelling to the North of Scotland, Rob discovers the story of the British Oil Industry though it’s incredible engineering; from first oil to today’s innovative rigs.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #1
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 且看50年代的廣告活動如何推出新的美國傳統和明天會更好的承諾.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how ad campaigns from the 50s launched new American traditions and the promise of a bright tomorrow.

epg.programme_title_en: The Real Mad Men Of Advertising #2
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 審視60年代的廣告男女,以及他們如何用智慧和嘲諷來接觸新受眾,因而改革整個產業.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Examine 60s ad men and women and how they used wit and irony to reach a new audience, consequently revolutionizing the industry.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 瞭解P-47雷霆式戰鬥機如何在德國和太平洋地區制霸空戰,還能同時對地面造成破壞.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: See how the P-47 Thunderbolt dominated the skies while dealing destruction on the ground in both Germany and the Pacific.
